independent_model.scope: Read-only code/log/artifact audit; no fit/epoch/model selection/threshold adjustment or previous file mutations. Only this new JSON is written.
independent_model.alignment: Origin is first target hour, offsets0..23 or0..744; last observed hour is origin-1, leads1..24 or1..745. Lag1 feature is the completed prior hour. Classical training labels are filtered to prefix end and neural windows end inside the fitting prefix.
independent_model.selection: Each CV sensor schema uses its training prefix. Neural inner-tail feature selection/scaling uses the shorter inner-fit prefix excluding the holdout. April test choices are frozen in March; final weights/scalers can fit April history, feature schemas and epochs remain frozen.
independent_model.arimax_scope: Coefficients and exog normalization fit once at fold start; past observations update state only. Future24 exog derives from known calendar and target/sensor lag24/168 strictly before origin. No ARIMAX745 model is claimed.
independent_model.long_feature_scope: XGB/Ridge745 use explicit origin-fixed last-day/week phase analogues (mod24/168), not actual future sensor/target readings. Neural long uses fixed past context only.
independent_model.architecture_claim: Pinned official cores compact locally retrained. iTransformer cross-variate inputs supervise explicit aggregate target; PatchTST channel-independent current inference has no sensor-to-module mixing. Sensor channels can affect shared fitted weights as auxiliary training tasks, and13 module predictions are inverse-scaled then summed.
qualifications: Neural day final schema was selected at March31; neural long final schema is conservatively reused from March28, not reselected at March31. Generic planner March31 wording is day-specific.
Small association or low model-specific importance does not prove intrinsic absence of predictive signal.
April/May were seen in earlier EDA; this controlled revision is not pristine prospective validation.
Unknown hierarchy/units and missing real fault labels remain provider-data limitations; no unit correction was made.
Classical CLI uses a stored fixed720-hour context and is not a general new-history operational pipeline.

limitations: Replay and numeric checks do not prove that a model predicts future load well.
Existing April/May EDA precludes a pristine prospective test claim.
Source unit and meter hierarchy uncertainty is not resolved by these tests.
